question: Estimate the cost of running a 24x7 fintech customer support center in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Major fintech (PhonePe / Paytm scale, ~250M MAU)? Yes.
Total annual cost of CS operations (incl. infra + tech + people)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total CS + T&S headcount (per Q98 of marketing doc): ~9,000-10,000.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Office facilities (rent + utilities) for 4-5 sites: ~₹40 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total CS + T&S headcount (per Q98 of marketing doc)
- Salaries (avg ₹3.5L/year per agent fully loaded incl benefits)
- Tech (ticketing system, voice infra, AI chatbot license)

calculationFlow: Total CS + T&S headcount (per Q98 of marketing doc): ~9,000-10,000.
- Salaries (avg ₹3.5L/year per agent fully loaded incl benefits): 9,500 × ₹3.5L = ~₹330 Cr.
- Office facilities (rent + utilities) for 4-5 sites: ~₹40 Cr.
- Tech (ticketing system, voice infra, AI chatbot license): ~₹35 Cr.
